editorial:
Ever felt the pressure to look a certain way just to get someone to like you? You will feel for the main character here, a girl who gets her heart broken because of her weight. She decides to go on a crazy, extreme diet to win her ex-boyfriend back. At first, it seems like it is actually working, and she looks great. But the movie quickly turns from a sad romance into a creepy nightmare. The vibe is very strange and uncomfortable, making you wonder just how far someone will go when they are desperate for love.

The acting is surprisingly good, and the way the hunger starts to take over her mind is genuinely scary. While the pacing is a bit slow in the middle, the shock value at the end makes up for it. If you like weird Japanese horror that focuses on body image and obsession, you will love this.
endingExplained: The ending takes a dark turn when the girl's hunger becomes impossible to control. Even though she looks thin and wins her boyfriend back, she cannot stop craving food. In a shocking twist, she loses her mind and begins to eat things she shouldn't. She ends up eating her own body and eventually her boyfriend too. It shows that her obsession with being thin destroyed her completely, leaving her as a monster driven by hunger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird body horror and dark twists.
